name: Manabe Yukari
source:
Yukari has a very affable personality, which is why she has a good relationship with all of her classmates, regardless of gender. Thanks to her wide array of social connections, she is always up-to-date on the latest gossip and current news from the girl network in her school.

Those around her note that although she is very knowledgeable about people, she knows almost nothing about herself.
